newsitem.title: FRANCE: French coffee roaster KJS raises retail prices.
newsitem.headline: French coffee roaster KJS raises retail prices.

text.p: French coffee roaster Kraft Jacobs Suchard (KJS) will raise retail prices of its roasted arabica coffees by four francs per kilo, effective February 24, industry sources said on Tuesday.
Kraft Jacobs Suchard officials could not be immediately reached for confirmation.
"The price hike applies to arabica coffees only," one source specified.
KJS, part of the Philip Morris group, has a French market share of some 42 percent.
The move was designed to offset the cost of an increase in raw material prices and a firmer dollar, sources said.
